اعتورن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَوَرْنَ (iʕtawarna) /iʕ.ta.war.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
# اُعْتُوِرْنَ (uʕtuwirna) /uʕ.tu.wir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
# اِعْتَوِرْنَ (iʕtawirna) /iʕ.ta.wir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
